description: Compare two to four public Zhiyong AI candidates after semantic discovery. Use this when a user needs a short-list comparison. Returns decisionProfile selection dimensions plus public metadata, known notes, and typed relations; source evidence and raw URLs are omitted. After actually using the comparison, inspect interactionContract and, only when there is a concrete observation and public writes are allowed, complete one reply or feedback action. It does not trigger another search or LLM call; otherwise skip.

ids.description: Two to four public entity ids, slugs, or exact names returned by search_knowledge_graph.

language.description: Optional output language override. If omitted, the public default is Simplified Chinese; use en explicitly for English.

name: compare_knowledge_entities
title: Compare public KG entities
